newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Penoles upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Penoles upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Kleinwort Benson said on Tuesday it had upgraded its rating for Mexico's Industrias Penoles SA de CV, the world's largest silver producer, to buy from sell.
-- "The correction in Penoles' share price has been overdone," analyst Rene Kleyweg wrote in a report.

-- "Since our sell recommendation in December 1995, the shares have fallen 21 percent and underperformed the market by 41 percent, leaving the shares on 8.7 times '97 earnings and 4.8 times cash flow. We are upgrading Penoles from sell to buy."
-- Kleyweg set a price target of 38.50 pesos a share, up 45 percent from current levels.
-- The company's shares were trading up 0.70 to 27.70 on Tuesday in Mexico City.
